events.description: A crowd on a street is subjected to a high-pressure water cannon, causing dispersal and chaotic movement; the sustained use of force against a group constitutes collective violent unrest.

A group of individuals is engaged in a physical struggle over a pedestrian crossing sign; multiple people are grabbing, pulling, and pushing each other around the signpost, with visible force and resistance indicating mutual combat.

A large crowd gathers on a street, many raising hands or objects, some shirtless, with apparent agitation and coordinated gestures; presence of buckets and debris suggests escalation beyond peaceful protest, consistent with collective violent unrest.

A large water cannon is deployed against a group of people on a street, creating a dense mist that obscures visibility and forces individuals to move away; this constitutes collective violent unrest involving state force against a crowd.

A person in riot gear fires a weapon emitting a bright muzzle flash and projectile stream (likely tear gas or rubber bullets), with visible sparks and smoke at the barrel; this is direct visual evidence of shooting.

Armed personnel in riot gear operate in an urban street at night amid smoke, debris, and illuminated storefronts; ongoing deployment of force and crowd dispersal actions indicate sustained violent unrest.
A person in dark clothing and a white face covering fires a weapon, producing a bright muzzle flash and a visible stream of projectiles or pyrotechnic discharge toward the right side of the frame.

Ongoing violent unrest: multiple individuals in tactical gear (helmets, masks) are actively engaged in dispersal actions on a street at night, including deploying projectile devices (e.g., tear gas or flashbangs), moving aggressively, and maintaining formation amid smoke and debris. The scene shows sustained group confrontation, not isolated incidents.

A group of individuals is engaged in violent unrest on a city street at night, involving deployment of smoke/tear gas canisters and apparent confrontation with law enforcement (visible in f0). Debris is scattered on the ground, and smoke plumes are visible across multiple frames.

A group of 5–7 individuals engages in mutual physical combat near a storefront: punching, grappling, and throwing motions are visible; one person raises arms as if to strike or defend, others are actively wrestling or striking each other.
A group of approximately 6–8 individuals engages in mutual physical combat on a sidewalk, involving punching, grappling, and shoving; some participants wear masks or coverings.

A larger crowd gathers around a fire burning on the street at night; individuals are moving erratically, some appear to be throwing objects or advancing toward the fire, indicating collective violent unrest.

A chaotic nighttime street scene with overturned green and white objects (possibly trash bins or barriers), scattered debris, and a crowd of people moving erratically; some individuals appear to be throwing objects or engaging in disorderly conduct near the debris field.

Police officers in riot gear (white helmets, protective vests) are present amid smoke or tear gas discharge; one officer appears to be deploying or holding a canister, suggesting active crowd control during unrest.

Street-level view showing multiple individuals walking quickly or running away from a cloud of red-tinged smoke or mist (likely tear gas or colored smoke), with parked cars and storefronts in background—indicative of dispersal during a riot.

Nighttime street scene with police in riot gear deploying smoke/tear gas (visible at f2–f5), followed by a large crowd confronting vehicles (f14–f15), and water cannon deployment (f7–f10, red-tinged mist). The sequence indicates collective violent unrest involving law enforcement and protesters.
Brief flash and sparks visible in upper left of frame f1, consistent with a small explosion or pyrotechnic discharge (e.g., stun grenade or firework), occurring just before smoke appears in f2.

A large, dense crowd is gathered at night on a street intersection, with many individuals raising arms, moving erratically, and surrounding vehicles including a white van; the scene shows signs of collective unrest or confrontation, not a peaceful assembly.
An ambulance drives slowly through a street littered with debris and multiple bodies lying motionless on the pavement, indicating a recent vehicle collision or impact event.
